parameters.name: ElasticBandwidth
parameters.description:
The burstable protection bandwidth that you want to set. Unit: Gbps.
> You can call [DescribeElasticBandwidthSpec](~~91502~~) to query the available burstable protection bandwidth specifications.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance.
> The instance must be in a normal state. You can call [DescribeInstanceIds](~~157459~~) to query the IDs of all Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances.
